title: How to Harvest in Stardew Valley: Right-Click a Parsnip; Kale Needs a Scythe
h1: How to Harvest in Stardew Valley: Right-Click a Parsnip; Kale Needs a Scythe
description: Stand beside a ripe parsnip and right-click or press X. Kale, amaranth, wheat, unmilled rice, and fiber seeds come off with a scythe swing. Count growth from the day after planting, and a dry day moves the ready day back.
author: Stardew Valley Planner Team

cover.alt: Illustration of a farm: leafy crops in tilled soil beside a crate of orange roots, three pumpkins and a hoe, rows of yellow stalks with a scythe and a vine trellis, and a brown-roofed building with plants in its windows.

figure.alt: Diagram of Stardew Valley harvest controls: Right-Click or X for a parsnip, Left-Click or C with a scythe for kale, wheat, amaranth, unmilled rice, and fiber, an axe for a giant crop, plus trellis and season-change rules.
figure.caption: Schematic: Stardew Valley crop harvest methods, with Right-Click or X for a parsnip, a scythe swing for kale, wheat, amaranth, unmilled rice, and fiber, plus an axe for giant crops, blocked trellises, and the day-28 season change.
